_comment: Hand-maintained overlay. Everything else on the page is derived from disk by build.py. Grades come from the portfolio audit; re-audit before trusting an old one.

alexharper-website-repo.note: Own studio site. GBP is live at 5.0 with 2 reviews. Open: services list, owner photos, zero citations.
alexharper-website-repo.blurb: My own studio site: services, plans, written guarantees, and case studies.

hs-proposals.note: Client pricing and referral arrangements. Local git, no remote, deliberately.

blessyourpaws-website-repo.note: Best image pipeline in the portfolio: srcset, 74 percent WebP, content-hash cache busting. Open: skip links, 90 missing alt, no CI.
blessyourpaws-website-repo.blurb: A breeder site with per-puppy pages, a waitlist, a purchase agreement, and a full responsive photo pipeline.

carvercowood-website-repo.note: Rich schema with AggregateRating and FAQPage. Gallery page is 3.8 MB.
carvercowood-website-repo.blurb: Family-owned woodworking in Louisville: live-edge tables, epoxy bar tops, and custom furniture from local hardwood.

faithsblissfuldelights-website-repo.note: Live on custom domain but missing .nojekyll and a 404. Overview page is 3.9 MB.
faithsblissfuldelights-website-repo.blurb: A made-to-order home bakery in Bellevue, Ohio: a sweet menu and gallery, plus a simple custom-order request flow.

kingdomfamilycompanions-website-repo.note: Launch blockers: Formspree ID, health claim wording versus the OFA records, two visible placeholders.
kingdomfamilycompanions-website-repo.blurb: A static rebuild replacing a Wix cart with an inquiry-first flow, plus linked health testing for every parent dog.

lorihuss-website-repo.note: Only repo that passes site-checks completely clean alongside Bless Your Paws.
lorihuss-website-repo.blurb: A Louisville leadership and well-being coach: one-on-one coaching, speaking, and healthcare consulting.

marysbakingcorner-website-repo.note: Thin at 1,454 words across 5 pages. Schema on one page only.
marysbakingcorner-website-repo.blurb: A home bakery site with a menu, a gallery, and an order request form.

mldesigns-website-repo.note: work.html is 14.2 MB fully loaded. Highest priority performance fix in the portfolio.
mldesigns-website-repo.blurb: A portfolio site for a design and build shop, organized around finished work.

phillipshaircutting-website-repo.note: Good HairSalon schema. Thin at 1,174 words, no 404, no image dimensions.
phillipshaircutting-website-repo.blurb: A haircutting site with services, hours, and directions.

auburnmuse-website-repo.note: Draft. Pending Formspree ID, more photos, socials, domain.
auburnmuse-website-repo.blurb: A photography portfolio with a filterable gallery and a simple booking inquiry.

detailzmatter-website-repo.note: Draft. Tracks 62 source photos despite a .gitignore. Only 2 of 6 pages have one H1. No CI.
detailzmatter-website-repo.blurb: A detailing site with service tiers, a gallery of finished work, and a booking request.

breazealebros-website-repo.note: No 404, no image dimensions anywhere, leftover OnePage preview to delete.
breazealebros-website-repo.blurb: A handyman and general contractor in Montgomery, Texas: roofing, concrete, remodels, tile, and repairs.

cornerstonesvcs-website-repo.note: Not under version control. Highest priority in the portfolio: git init and push.
cornerstonesvcs-website-repo.blurb: A painting contractor site: services offered, recent work, and a quote request.

calvaryroad-website-repo.note: Standout: 11 legacy redirect stubs preserve 20 years of inbound links.
calvaryroad-website-repo.blurb: Moved a New Albany, Indiana congregation off a twenty-year-old platform onto a fast, mobile-first site they own outright.

hope-website-repo.note: Most under-built of the live sites. Schema on 1 of 8 pages, no 404, no image dimensions.
hope-website-repo.blurb: A warm site for a Warsaw, Indiana congregation: service times, directions, and a welcoming path for first-time visitors.

lbc-website-repo.note: All 37 checker errors come from one leftover crop-options.html. Delete it and add CI.
lbc-website-repo.blurb: A static rebuild for a Marion, Indiana congregation, replacing a hosted template while keeping Breeze and Tithe.ly.

roanoke-website-repo.note: Staff self-publish the Torch newsletter. Missing .nojekyll. Cloudflare cutover pending.
roanoke-website-repo.blurb: A church site on Cloudflare where staff publish the monthly Torch newsletter themselves.

inf-website.note: Live commercial site with no robots.txt and no sitemap.xml. Four live JobPostings valid through Oct 31.
inf-website.blurb: A corporate site for an IT and leadership firm: services, who they serve, careers, and an easy way to start a conversation.

inf-help-center-repo.note: Articles and assistant only. Azure not provisioned.

inf-learning-repo.note: Phase 0 built. Pending corrections email, GHE remote, Azure.

inf-projects-dashboard-repo.note: Governance overlay on ConnectWise, not a PM tool.

inf-pto-dashboard-repo.note: Generated data holds PII and is gitignored.

phc-help-center-repo.note: Uses feat(scope) / fix(scope) commit style. Match it.

phc-sharepoint-annual-folder.note: Phase 1 done. Vaccinations row can block sites.

harperfinance-repo.note: D1 overrides on the Era baseline. data.js is never written to. Fetch before deploy.

williamssisters-website-repo.note: Generated from data/*.json by scripts/build_site.py. Edit the JSON, not the HTML. kitchens.html is 8 MB.
williamssisters-website-repo.blurb: A seven-sister family cookbook, generated from JSON, with a per-sister login editor.

site-checks.note: Run python check_site.py ../<repo> before committing any site.

form-backend-worker.note: Cloudflare Worker with D1 and Turnstile. One endpoint for all sites.

puppyconnection-website-repo.note: Harvest stage: 107 files of scraped copy, no built site, no git. site:false keeps it off the grid until there is something to show.

braveheartedbirth-website-repo.note: Single page design mockup, not a build. Copy needs the em dash pass.
braveheartedbirth-website-repo.blurb: A single-page redesign mockup rather than a build.

laytonchapel-website-repo.note: Static rebuild replacing a SermonAudio template. Durability-first content, keyless YouTube embeds, brand green #00A652.
laytonchapel-website-repo.blurb: A Gospel-focused rebuild for a Spring Lake, North Carolina church: service times, what they believe, and sermons.

inf-keeper-provisioning.note: Batch-file generator. Throwaway-tenant test and the General versus Locations decision still open.
